verdict.rationale: The Search API is documented as letting you manage indices and records, and Algolia searches a copy of your data that you send to it. This implies record-level writes rather than full reindexes, but the evidence never explicitly describes add, update, or delete operations or how quickly changes become searchable. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of incremental add/partial-update/delete record operations, any near-real-time indexing latency claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration of update propagation speed.
